lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense cluster of high-luminance, roughly circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits. The spots are arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows, with higher spatial frequency in the dorsal-lateral transition zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal spot rows to create a grid-like topology across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally across the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with specular highlights on the upper margin and narrow shadow cast below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) visible near the posterior ventral margin of the shark's body.
